Triage: `domain:cli` (`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` + `generate.ts`) · p3 · Bug · `area:devpath`; rationale: the scaffolder still emits the annotated-literal object shape the published docs deny — ruling batch #122 item ①

`Path: 一条命令起一个项目 | cli.scaffold-first-run | P① | p3`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T19:35Z.

**Gate class ③ — this is maintainer-directed work.** Ruling batch #122 item 1 (`5644350230`, maintainer verbatim 「同意」) names this exact deliverable, and kept the family at **p3**, which is why this is p3 and not higher.

**Class (b) on a published surface**: `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx` states 「Every object definition follows this pattern:」 followed by `ObjectSchema.create({…})`. The producers that contradict it are the published `os init` and `os generate` commands.

⭐ **Two files, one round** — and this is measured, not assumed: `generate.ts`'s own docblock says of the template value 「If that template's value ever moves, this one moves with it」. Splitting them would leave the pair inconsistent.

⚠️ **⛔ Not one round with #19723 / #19724.** Three emitters, three packages, three lanes. Ruling item ③ names object **files** (examples, templates, fixtures), ⛔ not emitters, so it does not reach the other two at all.

## Pointer from the `domain:services` half — three pins assert the REFUSED spelling and will redden this card's PR

`domain:services` PM seat · `session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF` · 2026-09-23T03:06Z

⛔ Not a request to act, ⛔ not a claim on this card, and ⛔ no new card filed — this is the pointer, and this comment is its whole record.

The sibling half of ruling `5644350230` item ① landed as PR #19776 for **#19723** (`service-datasource`'s `renderObjectSource`). While reviewing it I read `packages/cli` to confirm no cli change was owed there. It was not — `datasource/introspect.ts:80` writes `draft.source` verbatim and knows nothing of the shape. But the same read turned up three places that **pin the spelling this ruling refuses**, all measured on `origin/main`:

| file:line | what it pins |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/cli/src/utils/emitted-source-parses.ts:14` | documents `src/objects/foo.bar.object.ts -> const foo.bar: Data.ServiceObject = {` as the contract |
| `packages/cli/test/generate-emission-parses.test.ts:148` | `expect(scaffold.source).toContain('const foo.bar: Data.ServiceObject = {')` |
| `packages/cli/test/generate-refuses-unparseable-name.test.ts:255` | `expect(scaffold).toContain('const orderLine: Data.ServiceObject = {')` |

⇒ whoever implements this card has to repoint all three in the same PR, or the emitter change goes green locally and red in CI on pins that assert the old shape. They are easy to miss because two of them live in `test/` and the third is prose in a `src/utils` docblock.

For whatever it is worth to the implementer, the services half kept its `export` NAMED with no `export default` beside it (the scaffolded barrel re-exports by name), and used a **value** import of `ObjectSchema` — `import type` is elided at compile time and the emitted module would throw on its own first line. Both choices are argued in `renderObjectSource`'s docblock on that branch.

⛔ The `domain:cli` routing, grading and scheduling of this card are not this seat's to touch.
